plants.name: Jacaranda mimosifolia
plants.description: Rain-like clouds of lavender-blue trumpet flowers cover the bare branches of this tree. They carpet streets and pavements in violet as they fall.
plants.funFact: Jacaranda is native to South America, but Pretoria now has tens of thousands of them, and its spring bloom is a city-wide event.

plants.name: Cosmos bipinnatus
plants.description: Airy, daisy-like blooms on slender stems with feathery foliage sway above gardens and roadsides. The flowers are loved by pollinators and make long-lasting cut flowers.
plants.bloomingSeason: Summer through autumn (about June to November)
plants.location: Native to Mexico; widely grown in gardens and fields across Japan, where it is called 'akizakura' (autumn cherry blossom)
plants.funFact: In Japan, cosmos is called 'autumn cherry blossom' because its soft petals and mass plantings remind people of spring sakura.

plants.name: Camellia sasanqua
plants.description: This glossy evergreen shrub brings late-season color to autumn gardens with single or loose, semi-double blooms. The flowers are often lightly scented and have showy golden stamens.
plants.bloomingSeason: Autumn to early winter (October to November and beyond)
plants.location: Native to Japan; grown in temperate gardens in the Northern Hemisphere, including the UK
plants.funFact: Sasanqua camellias flower earlier than the more familiar winter-blooming Camellia japonica, so they open while many other garden plants are fading.
